summary_en: This phase 2 study tests nemtabrutinib with rituximab in people with previously untreated mantle cell lymphoma. Nemtabrutinib is taken by mouth once a day on days 1-28 of each 28-day cycle, and rituximab is given into a vein. Induction lasts up to 6 cycles and maintenance up to 24 cycles, as long as there is no disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; the record does not state the main outcome measure.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa nemtabrutinib junto con rituximab en personas con linfoma de células del manto que no han recibido tratamiento previo. El nemtabrutinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el rituximab se administra por vena. La fase de inducción dura hasta 6 ciclos y la de mantenimiento hasta 24 ciclos, siempre que no haya progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable; el registro no indica cuál es el resultado principal que se mide.
who_for: ECOG performance status of 2 or lower
Diagnosis of mantle cell lymphoma confirmed by biopsy testing
Needs treatment and has not received prior systemic cancer therapy
Measurable lymph node or extranodal lymphoma on imaging
not_for: Chronic systemic steroid use above 20 mg/day prednisone equivalent
Unstable heart disease, including heart attack within the past 6 months
Corrected QT prolongation above 450 msec or other significant ECG abnormalities
Primary or secondary CNS lymphoma or history of CNS lymphoma
